The **Daisycutter** is a ranged weapon in *Fallout 76*.

The Daisycutter is a Fat Man equipped with the MIRV Launcher mod and usually starts with standard paint. It has the Lightweight legendary effect, which reduces its weight by 90%.

- Fat Man - The standard version of this weapon.
- The Guarantee - A unique Fat Man given as a Survival mode reward from April 16–22, 2019.

This weapon is given as a reward after completing the quest An Organic Solution. Like all other quest rewards, the item scales depending on what level the player is when it is awarded.
